name: Extras
author: Ramón
description: Small quality-of-life extras for WanGP. Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on Mac) starts a generation from anywhere in the Video Generator tab, prompt box included: it clicks Generate, or Add New Prompt To Queue while a generation is running. Also blocks accidental back/forward navigation (mouse side buttons, Alt+Left/Right, browser back gesture). Keeps the Reference Library image-reference bar hidden while the native Reference Images input is unavailable; does not enable unsupported model inputs. New in 0.3.0: a "Clear outputs" button under the Video Generator gallery sends the files of WanGP's output folder to the Recycle Bin after showing the exact list and asking for confirmation; the frames folder is kept and nothing is deleted permanently.
